description: S-L1 Q03 honest verification tiers (SS N-62) plus Q-L1-16(a) respell single_pass -> single. Writers stop stamping two_pass_verified on rows nothing double-checked: only rows an independent re-derivation compared through two_pass_verdict keep two_pass_verified; rows a check matched against a classical reference or relay-compared become classical_match (the ga_strength shadbala, ga_tajaka varsha and ga_sade_sati duration/ordering checks are self-referential, bounds-only or plausibility guards and stay `single`); per-varga ashtakavarga rows documented_approximation; esoteric/derived extensions computed_extension; sarva-mismatch rows floored; everything else single. Changes ONLY verification_pass_status (no value, no row-set, no category change, expected class changes 0). Takes effect only after the S-L1 rebuild of ga_sensitive, ga_nakshatra, ga_sensitive_degree, ga_sade_sati, ga_strength, ga_panchanga, ga_structural, ga_dashas, ga_tajaka. Not machine-checkable by flip_detector: l1_tajik_varsha_year_lords (not a compared table; 240 canon rows two_pass_verified -> single: the three varsha checks are not a classical-table match) and chart_dashas tier (the detector compares dasha row sets and start shifts, not dasha tier; mudda 240 + narayana 105 canon rows two_pass_verified -> classical_match). Full per-emitter transition table, per-chart counts and reconciliation with the audit (PR #2852, v1.1 section 1): evidence/tiers_evidence_v1_2.json (v1_0 and v1_1 are superseded, write-once and left in place). J1 items: ashtakavarga 337 / sum-of-seven (kept classical_match) verifies the tables, not the chart-specific bindus; the upagraha two_pass_verified comparison has partial authorship independence (the in-repo BPHS algebra is documented as matching drik.py) and shares the Sun longitude input with PyJHora (a Sun error is invisible to it).

may_change.expected_direction: verification_pass_status only. Canonical chart (482012f1) rows whose tier changes: 19,905 = two_pass_verified->single 8,775 (incl. the 320 ga_sade_sati cycle/phase examined-key rows), two_pass_verified->classical_match 160 (ga_nakshatra join 100 + Yogi 60), two_pass_verified->computed_extension 35, two_pass_verified->floored 85, single_pass->single 2,076 (incl. the 210 examined shadbala rows), single_pass->classical_match 960 (raw ashtakavarga bindu only), single_pass->documented_approximation 7,800, classical_match->single 14 (hard-coded ga_strength naisargika/required_rupa). Abhinandan (1c826d5a): 9,170. Kiran (cb73cd3d): 13,849. 705 two_pass_verified rows across the three charts (265 canonical) are unchanged. After the rebuild canonical tiers: two_pass_verified 265, classical_match 1,120, documented_approximation 7,800, computed_extension 35, floored 85, single 10,865.
may_change.note: No expected_count: the per-chart totals differ (canon 19,905 / abhi 9,170 / kiran 13,849) and expected_count is a single bound for the chart compared; a stale-build chart (abhi/kiran) rebuilds into the same classes. Only the tier change type is declared: any value/appeared/disappeared/occurrence_count change in these categories is NOT attributable to this lane.

Declared for completeness: the detector does not compare chart_dashas tier today. mudda level 1 (canon 240 rows) and narayana level 1 (canon 105 rows) two_pass_verified -> classical_match. Vimshottari stays two_pass_verified per row; its row set and start timestamps are unchanged by this lane.
